memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: independent in ADLs, walks unaided around home, uses cane for outdoor walks. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative). falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal). medicines: 6 regular (cetirizine, fluticasone, montelukast, ferrous sulfate OD, ferrous sulfate alternate days, vitamin D). mood: reports occasional irritability, denies depression. carers: son Rajesh, lives nearby. goals: "I want to stay active and keep my garden."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
cetirizine 10 mg HS
fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD
montelukast 10 mg HS
ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD
ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days
vitamin D3 1000 IU OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin: 10.2 g/dL (ref 13.0-17.0)
Serum ferritin: 12 ng/mL (ref 30-400)
MCV: 78 fL (ref 80-100)
Total serum IgE: 210 IU/mL (ref <100)
Skin prick test: positive to house dust mite (3+ wheal)

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Allergy: house dust mite – allergic rhinitis with sneezing, nasal congestion, itchy eyes on exposure.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (85% predicted), FVC 3.2 L (88% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.88. No obstructive pattern.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referred to ENT specialist Dr. S. Reddy for persistent allergic rhinitis despite intranasal steroid and antihistamine. Request skin prick testing review and consider immunotherapy.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: ENT reply: Patient examined, nasal eosinophilia confirmed. Recommended continuation of fluticasone, add azelastine nasal spray BD, consider sublingual immunotherapy after 3 months. No structural pathology.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: My nose is still stuffy in the mornings and I feel tired. The iron tablets upset my stomach sometimes.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: ADL independent, occasional knee pain on stairs. cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (negative). falls: none last year, gait slightly antalgic right, timed up-and-go 11 seconds (borderline). medicines: 6 regular (same). mood: reports low energy, denies sadness. carers: son Rajesh. goals: "I want to walk the park without getting breathless."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD (take with breakfast)
ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days (stop if GI upset)
add vitamin C 500 mg OD with iron

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin: 11.8 g/dL (ref 13.0-17.0)
Serum ferritin: 28 ng/mL (ref 30-400)
MCV: 80 fL (ref 80-100)

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: manages garden, uses walking stick for longer walks. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative). falls: none last year, gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal). medicines: 6 regular (cetirizine, fluticasone, montelukast, ferrous sulfate OD, ferrous sulfate alternate days, vitamin D). mood: improved energy, denies depression. carers: son Rajesh. goals: "I want to keep my independence and travel to see my daughter."

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-01-15 at 10:30 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni for routine geriatric review.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: independent, walks 2 km daily with cane. cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (negative) – annual screen, score 2 or less would be positive; here 3, so negative. falls: none last year, gait normal, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal). medicines: 7 regular (added vitamin C). mood: good, denies depression. carers: son Rajesh. goals: "I want to maintain my current activity level."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
montelukast 10 mg HS (continue)
cetirizine 10 mg HS (continue)
fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD (continue)
azelastine nasal spray 1 spray each nostril BD (new)
ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD
ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days
vitamin C 500 mg OD
vitamin D3 1000 IU OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:

Serum ferritin: 45 ng/mL (ref 30-400)
MCV: 82 fL (ref 80-100)
Total serum IgE: 165 IU/mL (ref <100)

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: ADL independent, occasional mild dyspnea on exertion. cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (negative). falls: one minor slip at home 4 months ago, no injury, gait slightly slow, timed up-and-go 12 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise strength exercises and supportive footwear. medicines: 8 regular (cetirizine, fluticasone, azelastine, montelukast, ferrous sulfate OD, ferrous sulfate alternate days, vitamin C, vitamin D). mood: stable, denies depression. carers: son Rajesh. goals: "I want to stay free of falls and keep walking."
